name: Camera language for video-generation prompts
tagline: Per-model camera vocabulary for every video model in MODELS.md: which shot sizes, angles and moves each model is documented to follow, where it breaks, how to phrase one move per shot, and how to write multi-shot coverage. Research pass only: every row is untested in Ralphy until the camera test matrix runs.
description: How to write the camera part of a video prompt (text-to-video and image-to-video) so the model executes the intended framing and move. Covers 30 camera moves (locked-off, pan, tilt, push-in, pull-out, zoom, crash zoom, dolly zoom, truck, pedestal, crane, boom to overhead, arc, 360 orbit, tracking, follow, leading, handheld, shaky cam, steadicam, FPV fly-through, aerial drone, whip pan, rack focus, dutch roll, barrel roll, POV, selfie, over-the-shoulder, compound moves) with per-model notes for Kling 3.0 / O1, Veo 3.1, Seedance 2.0 / 1.5, Hailuo 2.3 and Wan 2.6 / 2.7, each labeled documented / community-reported / no info. Adds the Hailuo bracket command syntax, per-model multi-shot coverage phrasing for one scene, and an anti-pattern table. Post-production camera moves live in the editor virtual-camera reference (#567).
origin: notes/issues/566 research pass 2026-10-30 (official model docs and community reports; no Ralphy renders yet). Test matrix: docs/research/camera-language-test-plan.md.
